If you think it is an ingenious little thing in your brain called scientific thinking, you're wrong.

There is no explanation, no proving, no falsifying jut what accomplishes this experience of unity. No information in the physical substance of a brain can do this - therefore it is necessarily external and distributed across one's environment.
